name: @walkme-mobile/react-native-sdk
description: React Native bridge for the WalkMe SDK

scripts.codegen: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('build/codegen',{recursive:true})" && node ./node_modules/@react-native/codegen/lib/cli/combine/combine-js-to-schema-cli.js --platform all build/codegen/schema.json src && node ./node_modules/react-native/scripts/generate-specs-cli.js --platform android --schemaPath build/codegen/schema.json --outputDir build/codegen/android --libraryName WalkMeSdkSpec --javaPackageName com.walkme.rn --libraryType modules && node ./node_modules/react-native/scripts/generate-specs-cli.js --platform ios --schemaPath build/codegen/schema.json --outputDir build/codegen/ios --libraryName WalkMeSdkSpec --libraryType modules
